SKYD.headline: Why Skydance Stock Fell 28.5% Today
SKYD.description: Skydance stock dropped 28.5% on Wednesday due to a warrant dividend distribution to Class B shareholders. Each shareholder received one warrant per share, exercisable at $12 per share for 10 years. The warrants trade separately and are valued at approximately $1.1 billion. This restructuring did not represent actual value loss for eligible shareholders, as the warrant value offsets the stock price decline. The Ellison family and RedBird Capital were excluded from the warrant distribution.

LQDA.headline: LQDA Settles UTHR Disputes for $380.7M, Limits Yutrepia Label
LQDA.description: Liquidia Corporation has reached a global settlement with United Therapeutics, resolving all six pending legal disputes and ensuring continued access to Yutrepia for PAH patients. However, the company must pay $380.7 million in settlement obligations across 2026-2027, and the removal of the PH-ILD indication from Yutrepia's label narrows its approved use. The company reported preliminary Q3 2026 Yutrepia sales of $222.7 million and plans to advance pipeline candidate L606.
